input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for security config, routes, inventory application. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with inventory functionality, so that I can accomplish my inventory-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
